name: multiplehighlight
description: Highlight occurrences of symbols found in a meaningful JavaScript or TypeScript selection.

multipleHighlight.autoHighlightEnabled.description: Automatically highlight symbols when the editor selection changes.

multipleHighlight.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before recalculating highlights after a selection change.

multipleHighlight.minSelectedLines.description: Minimum number of selected lines that can trigger highlighting even when the selection is short.

multipleHighlight.minSelectionLength.description: Minimum selected character count that can trigger highlighting even on a single line.

multipleHighlight.maxSymbols.description: Maximum number of symbols to highlight from one selection.

multipleHighlight.maxFileSize.description: Maximum document size in characters that MultipleHighlight will scan.

multipleHighlight.supportedLanguages.description: VS Code language identifiers where automatic highlighting is enabled.

multipleHighlight.ignoreSingleCharacterS.description: Ignore one-character identifiers when extracting symbols from the selection.

multipleHighlight.includeOverviewRuler.description: Show symbol highlight markers in the editor overview ruler.

scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
